recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中保有三系造血與脂肪，但可見一排排卵圓大核、泡狀染色質與明顯核仁的大型細胞，沿著竇狀血管呈線狀排列並有分裂相；這種「在血管腔內排隊」的大細胞分布是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and fat
Large atypical cells with oval vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and pale cytoplasm
Linear, single-file arrangement of large cells within sinusoidal lumina
Mitotic figure among the intrasinusoidal large cells
Background erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and megakaryocytes without a mass-forming lesion
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis. Scattered large atypical cells with oval vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm are aligned in a linear, single-file pattern within sinusoidal spaces, with a mitotic figure present. There is no discrete interstitial mass or paratrabecular aggregate. The subtle intrasinusoidal distribution of large atypical cells, confirmed by CD20 immunostaining, is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HSTCL also shows a sinusoidal pattern but the cells are small to medium with scant cytoplasm and are CD3+ CD20-, usually gamma-delta TCR.
Megakaryocytes are much larger with lobulated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, and erythroid precursors have round dense nuclei; neither align single-file in sinusoids.
Morphologically similar but CD3/CD56 and EBER positive and CD20 negative.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with desmoplasia and are keratin positive, CD45 negative.
